lines.beaver_en: Hello. Which athlete are you introducing today?
lines.en: It's Park Seojun. He has competed in many events.

lines.learner: 썰매 경주에서 신기록을 세우고 금메달을 땄어요.
lines.en: He set a new record in a sled race and won gold.
lines.roman: sseolmae gyeongjueseo singirogeul seugo geummedareul ttasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, amazing. Does he do other events too?
lines.learner: 스키 점프 등 겨울 종목에서도 재능을 발휘했어요.
lines.en: He also showed talent in winter sports like ski jumping.
lines.roman: seuki jeompeu deung gyeoul jongmogeseodo jaeneungeul balhwihaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I heard he also played a racket sport.
lines.en: Yes, he got 20 wins in tennis matches.
The final. The third set was the deciding moment.

lines.beaver_en: Was there anything hard during the game?
lines.learner: 상대 선수가 퇴장당해서 선수도 많이 놀랐대요.
lines.en: His opponent was sent off, so he was very surprised.
lines.roman: sangdae seonsuga toejangdanghaeseo seonsudo mani nollatdaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What's the outlook for the main round?
lines.learner: 다음 달 본선에서도 좋은 기록을 기대해요.
lines.en: We expect good records in next month's main round too.
lines.roman: daeum dal bonseoneseodo joeun girogeul gidaehaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Could you tell us about his playing style too?
lines.en: When he's absorbed in a game, he focuses with wide eyes.
That's right. He finished every game smoothly.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks for the introduction. I'll cheer for him!
lines.learner: 시청해 주셔서 감사합니다. 다음에 또 만나요!
lines.en: Thank you for watching. See you next time!
